_comment: Copper Peptide Advanced Repair Serum, 2026-08-20. Bottle wording read off refs/product_tight.png; carton read face by face off the dieline. NOTE the Copper Peptide line shares one CARTON blue but three different CONTAINER blues - this serum is deep blue, the Day cream navy, the Night cream pale ice-blue. Treating them as one 'Copper Peptide blue' would be the same class of error as calling the silver face white.
product_desc: Skingenetix Copper Peptide Advanced Repair Serum: a 30ml frosted DEEP BLUE glass dropper bottle, straight-sided with square shoulders, fitted with a brushed satin aluminium collar and a white rubber-bulb pipette. The glass is a rich deep blue at the top fading downward to pale frosted at the base - a strong vertical gradient. Keep it BLUE and do not render it clear, navy-black, teal or purple. The collar metal is NEUTRAL SILVER-GREY with a fine vertical brushed grain and stays neutral next to the blue glass - never rose-gold, copper, champagne, brass or warm-tinted, and never a chrome mirror. PIPETTE PROPORTIONS: the white rubber bulb is an ELONGATED CAPSULE about 1.6 times taller than wide, standing about ONE THIRD the height of the glass body; bulb plus collar together about TWO THIRDS of it. Never short, squat, stubby or ball-shaped. Reproduce the front label exactly as in the reference, every character verbatim. These are the ONLY words on the bottle, in this order: (1) the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix', capital S then lower case, no trademark or copyright symbol anywhere; (2) 'COPPER PEPTIDE' - bold capitals, one line; (3) 'ADVANCED' then 'REPAIR SERUM' - two lines; (4) 'PREMIUM FORMULA'; (5) '2% GHK-CU  |  30ML' in small capitals. A narrow vertical rule sits to the left of the text block. INK COLOURS - these describe the ink each line is printed in and are NEVER themselves printed as words: the mark, wordmark, line 2, line 4 and line 5 are printed in white ink; line 3 and the vertical rule are printed in light cornflower-blue ink. No colour name appears as text. THE BOTTLE CARRIES ONLY THE LINES LISTED ABOVE - not the benefit lines, not 'ALL SKIN TYPES', not any ingredient list. Those are carton-only. BRAND ACCENT COLOUR: BLUE. Any brand colour, gradient or accent glow builds from that blue and cool neutrals - never gold, rose, purple, green or orange.
_packaging_desc_help: The carton blue is a medium steel/denim blue, LIGHTER than the bottle's deep blue. Read off the dieline.
packaging_desc:
The product carton is a tall slim rectangular box, 41 x 41 x 99mm, noticeably taller than it is wide. It has TWO large faces in different colours meeting at crisp edges, each colour holding right up to the edge. One large face is matte metallic MEDIUM STEEL BLUE - a denim blue, distinctly LIGHTER than the bottle's deep blue; the other is matte metallic brushed pale silver - not white cardboard, not a mirror. Both large faces carry the SAME lines, in this order top to bottom, and these are the ONLY words printed on them:
1. the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix'
2. 'COPPER' then 'PEPTIDE' - bold capitals, two lines
3. 'ADVANCED' then 'REPAIR SERUM' - bold capitals, two lines
4. 'ANTI-AGING' / 'FIRMING' / 'REPAIRING' - three separate lines
5. 'PREMIUM FORMULA'
6. 'ALL SKIN TYPES' - small
7. '2% GHK-CU  |  30ML' - small capitals
A narrow vertical rule sits to the left of the text block.
INK COLOURS - these describe the ink each line is printed in and are NEVER themselves printed as words. On the steel-blue face: lines 1, 3 and 6 and the vertical rule are printed in white ink, everything else in black ink. On the silver face: those same elements are printed in steel-blue ink and the rule is steel blue, everything else black. No colour name appears as text.
The narrow side panels are printed in the same steel blue and silver and carry ingredient and directions text too small to read - render it as fine unreadable print, never as placeholder words. FINISH: the dieline specifies 'Mat Metalic Blue' and 'Mat Metalic Silver', luxury satin. Render a soft brushed sheen with broad diffuse falloff across each face - never a mirror, never polished foil, never chrome. PRINT NOTHING NOT LISTED ABOVE - do not invent, translate, paraphrase or add wording, claims or ingredient names on any face.
